title: Third siege of Girona (Peninsular War)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Third siege of Girona (Peninsular War)", at revision 1370750650, opens: "The third siege of Girona occurred in northern Catalonia, Spain from 6 May to 12 December 1809, during the Napoleonic Wars. A significant event of the Peninsular War, France's Grande Armée lay siege to the town of Girona for seven months. Girona was strategically important because it controlled the main road between France and Spain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3101541, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1809 siege during the Peninsular War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
